client_certificate.description: PEM-encoded client certificate for TLS authentication. Can be set with the `KUBE_CLIENT_CERT_DATA` environment variable.

client_key.description: PEM-encoded client certificate key for TLS authentication. Can be set with the `KUBE_CLIENT_KEY_DATA` environment variable.

cluster_ca_certificate.description: PEM-encoded root certificates bundle for TLS authentication. Can be set with the `KUBE_CLUSTER_CA_CERT_DATA` environment variable.

config_context.description: Context to choose from the kube config file. Can be set with the `KUBE_CTX`environment variable.

config_context_auth_info.description: Authentication info context of the kube config (name of the kube config user, --user flag in kubectl). Can be set with the `KUBE_CTX_AUTH_INFO` environment variable.

config_context_cluster.description: Cluster context of the kube config (name of the kube config cluster, --cluster flag in kubectl). Can be set with the `KUBE_CTX_CLUSTER` environment variable.

config_paths.description: List of paths to the kube config file. Can be set with the `KUBE_CONFIG_PATHS` environment variable.

api_version.description: API version for the exec plugin.

command.description: Command to run for _Kubernetes_ exec plugin.

env.description: Environment variables for the exec plugin.

force_conflicts.description: If `true`, the field manager will force apply the changes by ignoring the conflicts.

host.description: The hostname (in form of URI) of _Kubernetes_ master. Can be set with the `KUBE_HOST` environment variable.

insecure.description: Whether server should be accessed without verifying the TLS certificate. Can be set with the `KUBE_INSECURE` environment variable.

password.description: The password to use for HTTP basic authentication when accessing the _Kubernetes_ master endpoint. Can be set with the `KUBE_PASSWORD` environment variable.

proxy_url.description: URL to the proxy to be used for all API requests. Can be set with the `KUBE_PROXY_URL` environment variable.

create.description: Timeout for resource creation; defaults to `10m`. This should be a string that can be [parsed as a duration] (https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as `30s` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are `s` (seconds), `m` (minutes), `h` (hours).

delete.description: Timeout for resource deletion; defaults to `10m`. This should be a string that can be [parsed as a duration] (https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as `30s` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are `s` (seconds), `m` (minutes), `h` (hours).

read.description: Timeout for resource or data source reads; defaults to `10m`. This should be a string that can be [parsed as a duration] (https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as `30s` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are `s` (seconds), `m` (minutes), `h` (hours).

update.description: Timeout for resource update; defaults to `10m`. This should be a string that can be [parsed as a duration] (https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as `30s` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are `s` (seconds), `m` (minutes), `h` (hours).

tls_server_name.description: Server name passed to the server for SNI and is used in the client to check server certificates against. Can be set with the `KUBE_TLS_SERVER_NAME` environment variable.

token.description: Token to authenticate a service account. Can be set with the `KUBE_TOKEN` environment variable.

username.description: The username to use for HTTP basic authentication when accessing the _Kubernetes_ master endpoint. Can be set with the `KUBE_USER` environment variable.

block.description: The K8s provider provides a way to manage _Kubernetes_ resources using _Terraform_. It maps to the _Kubernetes_ API using server-side-apply and field management.

api_version.description: API version of the resource to find.

kind.description: Kind of the resource to find.

name.description: Name of the resource to find.

namespace.description: Namespace of the resource to find; if the resource is namespaced this is required.

object.description: Resource object retrieved from the API server. The following fields are not returned; `status`, `metadata.creationTimestamp`, `metadata.generation`, `metadata.resourceVersion`, `metadata.selfLink`, `metadata.managedFields[*].time`.

read.description: Timeout for reading the data source; this defaults to the provider value if not set. This should be a string that can be [parsed as a duration] (https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as `30s` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are `s` (seconds), `m` (minutes), `h` (hours).

api_version.description: API version of the resources to find.

field_selector.description: Field selector for the resources to find.

kind.description: Kind of the resources to find.

label_selector.description: Label selector for the resources to find.

limit.description: Limit the number of resources to find.

namespace.description: Namespace of the resources to find.

objects.description: List of resource objects retrieved from the API server. The following object fields are not returned; `status`, `metadata.creationTimestamp`, `metadata.generation`, `metadata.resourceVersion`, `metadata.selfLink`, `metadata.managedFields[*].time`.

read.description: Timeout for reading the data source; this defaults to the provider value if not set. This should be a string that can be [parsed as a duration] (https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as `30s` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are `s` (seconds), `m` (minutes), `h` (hours).

git_tree_state.description: Git tree state of the server.
